title: The Bedrock Canon
summary: A canon on the unmoving stance and the heavy blows struck from it for students past the courses of the middle grade.

title: A Treatise on Quake and Tremor
summary: A treatise on sending quakes through ground and body together to throw foes down and break their holds.

title: The Monolith Course
summary: A course in raising single great columns of stone to crush and hold with qi spread through a living field.

title: Manual of the Moving Strata
summary: A manual on shifting the layers of the ground against one another with a field of qi to split and carry whole masses.

title: The Twin Pillar Treatise
summary: A treatise on raising pillars of stone in pairs so that one pins the foe and the other lands the blow.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Stone Drop
summary: A manual of plunging stone falls loosed from above and the spread stance that follows each fall.

title: The Paired Foundation Compendium
summary: A compendium on laying two foundations of stone side by side so one bears the user and one bears the strike.

title: The Wind-Sworn Earth Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of earth moves by which a wind-sworn student holds the ground against the gale and answers it.

title: Treatise on Bearing and Bedrock
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing through the stone and striking along it so that each blow lands true.

title: The Oath of the Unmoved Ground
summary: A manual of the sworn unmoved stance that gives no ground and fills the field with held earth qi.
